name: dynein axonemal heavy chain 9

function.text: DNAH9 is the approved symbol for dynein axonemal heavy chain 9. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in dynein intermediate chain binding; dynein light intermediate chain binding; cilium movement.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include ciliary dyskinesia, primary, 40 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Esophageal carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; Definitive GenCC assertion, ClinGen. Allele-specific review required.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: DNAH9 encodes dynein axonemal heavy chain 9. Its functions include dynein intermediate chain binding and dynein light intermediate chain binding.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include ciliary dyskinesia, primary, 40 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DNAH9 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and esophageal carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
